warnings: Generic atlas-derived anatomy; not patient-specific and not a clinical segmentation.
Venous purple/blue is a UI convention only; venous blood is dark red, not blue.
Do not infer flow direction, velocity, pressure, oxygenation, collateral status, stenosis, access feasibility, or perfusion from geometry or color.
Do not use for diagnosis, treatment planning, navigation, device sizing, procedural rehearsal, or any clinical decision.
